en.hubeali:
Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Al Amraky Bin Ali, 
(It has been narrated) from Ali<sup>asws</sup> son of Ja’far<sup>asws</sup>, from his brother<sup>asws</sup> Abu Al-Hassan<sup>asws</sup>, said,

‘I asked him<sup>asws</sup> about the saddle and the reins where is the silver, can one ride with it?’ So he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘If it is coated on and you are not able to remove it, so there is no problem, otherwise do not ride with it’.
en.sarwar: 3. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from al-‘Amrakiy ibn Ali from Ali ibn Ja‘far from his brother abu al-Hassan, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, who has said the following: “

I once asked abu al-Hassan, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, about the saddle and the rein in which silver is used; if it can be used. He (the Imam) said, ‘If it is in a whitewashing (painted) form which cannot be removed, then it is not harmful, otherwise, you must not ride with it.’”
